::: {.lede}
My research examines the overlap of technology and society: Social Media
Platforms and Persuasion, Text Analytics and Natural Language Processing, and the
Machine Learning and Optimization methods behind them.
:::

[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=zIXyg9IAAAAJ) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6686-6662) · [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Derya-Ipek-Eroglu) · [SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=4077439)

Full texts are linked where I can host them. If you hit a paywall, email me and I
will send you a copy.

## Students

I supervise undergraduate and graduate research, including summer projects. If
you are a Brockport student interested in working on something in this space, get
in touch before the term starts — the earlier the better.
